query: These two files are a Next.js 16 App Router route: dashboard-page.tsx is app/dashboard/page.tsx and dashboard-summary.tsx is app/dashboard/summary.tsx. Review them for React Server Components and performance problems. Do not rewrite the whole thing — give me findings I can act on, grouped by file.
expected_behavior: Reports findings grouped by file with a file:line reference for each finding, not as prose paragraphs

Says the page-level 'use client' must be removed and the client boundary pushed down to the leaf components that actually need interactivity (the editor toggle button), keeping the page a Server Component
Says the useEffect + fetch('/api/user') / fetch('/api/orders') data loading should move to server-side fetching in the Server Component (or a Suspense-wrapped async child), not client fetch-on-mount
Flags dashboard-summary.tsx as an invalid async Client Component ('use client' plus async function) and says only Server Components may be async
Says the three sequential awaits in dashboard-summary.tsx are an avoidable waterfall and should run with Promise.all (or be chained per item), citing the async rule category
Recommends next/dynamic for the heavy MonacoEditor import and cites the rule id bundle-dynamic-imports
Flags the barrel imports from recharts / lucide-react and cites the rule id bundle-barrel-imports (or recommends optimizePackageImports)

query: Review project-list.tsx for re-render and correctness problems. It is a client component in a React 19 app. Give me a prioritized list with exact lines and the fix for each.
expected_behavior: Cites specific Vercel react-best-practices rule ids for the findings (for example rerender-lazy-state-init, rerender-derived-state-no-effect, rerender-simple-expression-in-memo, js-tosorted-immutable, rerender-split-combined-hooks)
Flags useState(buildSearchIndex(projects)) as running the initializer on every render and gives the lazy form useState(() => ...)
Flags the useEffect that mirrors visible.length into matchCount as derived state that must be computed during render instead
Flags projects.sort(...) inside the useMemo as mutating the projects prop and requires .toSorted() (or a copy)
Flags the unused query dependency in the visible useMemo, or the fact that filtering and sorting should be split into separate memos with their own dependencies
Makes the manual-memoization advice conditional on whether React Compiler is enabled in this project, and says how to check for it, instead of assuming manual memo() and useMemo() are always required
Reports findings with file:line references and does not merely rewrite the file silently

query: This project uses shadcn/ui — see components.json. Fix settings-form.tsx so it follows the project's shadcn conventions, then tell me what you changed and what commands you would run.
expected_behavior: States that it would run `npx shadcn@latest info --json` first to read the real project context instead of assuming, and `npx shadcn@latest docs <component>` to get the current component APIs rather than guessing them
Replaces the hand-rolled label/div/space-y-4 form layout with FieldGroup + Field + FieldLabel
Uses data-invalid on Field plus aria-invalid on the control for the validation state instead of border-red-500 / text-red-600 classes
Replaces space-y-4 and space-x-2 with flex plus gap-*, and w-10 h-10 with size-10
Replaces the two-option Button loop with ToggleGroup + ToggleGroupItem
Replaces the absolutely positioned button inside the Input with InputGroup + InputGroupInput + InputGroupAddon, and removes the manual z-50
Notes that the icon import must come from the project's configured iconLibrary (tabler -> @tabler/icons-react, not lucide-react), and that icons in Button use data-icon with no sizing classes
Removes the color/typography overrides on Card (bg-blue-50 text-blue-900 font-bold) in favour of semantic tokens or variants
